# deps: tools: add benchcmp

Add `benchcmp` (`golang.org/x/tools/cmd/benchcmp`) to the Go toolset. **Motivation:** comparing benchmark runs before and after a change:

```bash
$ go test -run=NONE -bench=. > [old,new].txt
$  benchcmp old.txt new.txt
```

The `tools.go` fragment in the note is the standard shape of an entry: a blank import under the `tools` build tag plus a `//go:generate go install …` line.
